uutiset.t: Google-Tied Prepaid Bond Deals Delayed Due to Lackluster Demand
uutiset.s: Two prepaid energy deals totaling $3 billion, which featured Google parent company Alphabet Inc. as funding recipient, were delayed due to lackluster investor demand amid market volatility, according to a person familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: War-Driven Cost Squeeze Alarms Companies, Bank of America Says
uutiset.s: What began as an oil-market shock from the Iran war has broadened into a cost squeeze across the US, with business owners growing significantly more concerned about commodity prices.

uutiset.t: Australia’s Leader to Navigate Trade, Security in Talks With Xi
uutiset.s: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese will aim to navigate delicate security and trade issues when he meets Chinese President Xi Jinping on Friday, seeking to ease access for commodities to its biggest export partner.

uutiset.t: Tod’s Nears €400 Million Debt Refinancing Backed by Owners
uutiset.s: Tod’s SpA is close to securing a €400 million ($439 million) debt refinancing backstopped by the founder’s family that would ease financial pressure on the Italian luxury group, according to people familiar with the matter.
